pairs.question: Dum diribentur suffragia, vis potius villae publicae utamur umbra, quam privati candidati tabella dimidiata aedificemus nobis?
pairs.answer: Opinor non solum, quod dicitur, "malum consilium consultori est pessimum", sed etiam bonum consilium, qui consulit et qui consulitur, bonum habendum.
pairs.derivation: Axius proposes (genuine yes/no interrogative 'vis...?') waiting in the shade of the villa publica; Varro answers affirmatively that good counsel benefits both parties (followed in the text by 'Itaque imus, venimus in villam'). Dropped framing tags 'Axius mihi,' / 'inquit,' from the question and 'inquam,' from the answer; normalized initial capital and terminal '?'. Answer ends at first full stop, before 'Itaque imus...'.

pairs.question: Recipis nos in tuum ornithona, ubi sedes inter aves?
pairs.answer: Ego vero te praesertim, quoius aues hospitales etiam nunc ructor, quas mihi apposuisti paucis ante diebus in Villa Reatina ad lacum Velini eunti de controversiis Interamnatium et Reatinorum.
pairs.derivation: Axius asks Appius a genuine yes/no question (Recipis nos...?); Appius answers affirmatively ('Ego vero te praesertim' = yes, you especially). Dropped framing 'inquit,' from the question and 'Ille,' / 'inquit,' from the answer; normalized capitalization. Answer cut at first full stop ('...Reatinorum.'), before Appius turns to a fresh question 'Sed non haec... villa...?'.
